question: Is exit status / abnormal termination deterministic and faithful across backends?
answer: Self-consistency mostly holds (15/16 stable at N=3). Fidelity fails: DBI collapses signalled death to exit 1 in 7 of 8 cases and hangs twice; SaBRe hangs on SIGFPE, reports the wrong signal for SIGILL, and is NONDETERMINISTIC on thread-exit; ptrace mistranslates SIGTRAP.
cells: 16 modes x 3 backends = 48 (144 hermit runs + 16 native baselines)
negative_strength: one-sided 95% upper bound on a flake rate after 0/3 clean runs is ~63%; N=3 stability is NOT a determinism claim
